We will work with you to resolve any issues you are having. However, if you do post a negative feedback before giving us the chance to work with you, you will no longer be able to buy from our store.

All servers can be customized to fit your project and budget. With us, you just pay for what you need. We are ready to assist you with any IT questions you might have. Questions?
